versions.content: In case more than one CanIfRxPduCfg matches a received frame according to the rules set up by [SWS_CANIF_00951] and [SWS_CANIF_00952], a matched parameter of CanIfRxPduXLParams shall always be preferred over an unavailable configuration parameter. The matching shall then be executed in the following sequence: 1. SDU Type 2. Acceptance Field 3. VCID 4. Priority ID A match in a preceding element of this list shall always be preferred over a match in a following element, i.e. the look-up shall be executed based on an ordered list based on this sequence.
